name: Shijou Rinka
source: The student council president, who first meets the protagonist when she informs him that he would need to find other members to avoid being kicked out of the room that he uses as the club. [spoiler]Rinka does lose out in re-election in both Yui’s route and her own route. This involves Rinka’s self-realization that contrary to her beliefs, she is lonely and powerless.[/spoiler]
